name: Kontext style reference (new object, reference look)
description: Text-to-image on FLUX.1 Kontext where the input image is a STYLE reference only (ReferenceLatent, empty latent, denoise 1.0). The prompt names a new object; the reference passes on materials, paint and weathering. Use to make concepts that match an existing asset set (e.g. Tripo Studio kart parts) before image-to-3D. Not an editor: for edits use edit_image_kontext.

prompt.description: Describe the NEW object and say it shares the reference's materials/paint (e.g. 'a <object> made of the same weathered painted metal as the reference, isolated on plain grey background')
